stem.text: A catalytic converter reduces the amount of pollutants in the fumes from a car exhaust.
Which row identifies a pollutant and shows how it is removed by the action of the catalyst?

B.text: carbon monoxide; oxidised to carbon dioxide

C.text: oxides of nitrogen; oxidised to nitric acid

D.text: unburnt hydrocarbons; oxidised to carbon dioxide and hydrogen

D: oxidised to carbon dioxide and hydrogen
